title: Prior acts coverage (glossary of insurance and risk management terms)
claims: Defines prior acts coverage as a feature of claims-made policies that have either no retroactive date or a retroactive date earlier than the inception date of the policy.
updateCadence: glossary entries are revised by the publisher without a fixed schedule
notes: Fetched 2026-08-31; the definition was read off the page. IRMI is a commercial insurance reference publisher, not a regulator, so this is cited only to attribute an industry term of art and never for a legal requirement or a coverage outcome. The page shows no publication or revision date.
